caseNameFull: McLean v. Commissioner of Internal Revenue
attorneys: Mr. L. J. Benckenstein for petitioner. Assistant Solicitor General Fahy, Assistant Attorney General Clark, and Messrs. Richard H. Demuth and Warren F. Wattles for respondent.

opinions.text:
Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit *671denied.

Mr. L. J. Benckenstein for petitioner. Assistant Solicitor General Fahy, Assistant Attorney General Clark, and Messrs. Richard H. Demuth and Warren F. Wattles for respondent. Mr. Justice Jackson took no part in the consideration and decision of this application.
